big_case.notes: Marquee OT2026 separation-of-powers, statutory-immigration, and remedial-jurisdiction grant. Plenary review of Questions 1 and 2 tests whether the President may invoke 8 U.S.C. 1182(f) and 1185(a) alongside categorical front-end asylum discretion to foreclose statutory asylum applications under 8 U.S.C. 1158 across the southern border, and whether 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1) bars classwide injunctive relief. Dropping Question 3 narrows the case slightly away from a standalone trans-substantive Rule 23(b)(2)/Article III sequel to Trump v. CASA, Inc., keeping its primary impact focused on executive border authority and immigration remedies.
